subject: Make shinyapps.io user guide repo public so users can submit pull requests?

messages.author: 37da9a66299f2608
messages.subject: Make shinyapps.io user guide repo public so users can submit pull requests?
parts:
Hello,

While reading more about application tuning in the shinyapps.io user guide (http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/), I noticed a broken link [to what I presume to be a since-renamed section]. I know the user guide, which is fantastic btw, has been updated fairly recently, so I imagine catching this sort of thing is only a matter of time, but it seems like an easy fix would be to make the repo publicly available and allow users to submit pull requests. The alternatives–creating an entire thread on here or emailing support seem like overkill for minor edits–but I would happily commit the free labor if it's convenient while I'm working through the documentation anyway.

Thanks!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Make shinyapps.io user guide repo public so users can submit pull requests?

Mike,

It's a very interesting thought. We're discussing internally to see if this make sense and is feasible.

Thanks for the suggestion
-Andy
